comparison: attempt-construction05 matched reference-angle, front, and rear views
disposition: retain as a bounded visual improvement for diagnostic composition; whole-character likeness remains held

observations.improvement_over_05: The shoulder and elbow shield fields now read as a more continuous compact folded assembly. The lower course fills much of the former open band, and the rear view presents a single armored mantle silhouette rather than visibly separated upper and lower tufts. The shield length and mass are closer to the compact owner reference than the long scalloped blanket in 04.
observations.remaining_mantle_gap: The mantle still sits apart from the breast: front and rear views show a substantial smooth central body field and exposed support members between the shoulder shields. The reference has layered shoulder armor flowing into a fuller chest/neck construction. The candidate reads as two side shells attached around shoulder pivots, not a continuous breast-to-folded-wing assembly.
observations.surface_read: The repeated small plates create a recognizable layered shield at this gray render scale, but the rows remain regular and uniformly rounded; material alone cannot establish the reference's richer formed edges and hardware.
observations.other_visible_limits: The smooth barrel-like torso/neck and thin articulated limbs remain conspicuous whole-figure differences; this mantle-only judgment does not resolve them.

scope_limits: This is an image-based visual judgment, not a geometry-clearance or motion review.
The owner reference is a perspective illustration, so no real-world dimensions are inferred.
Retaining this candidate diagnostically does not imply likeness acceptance.
